_comment: HywMill M5 politics. Standing uses Millénaire's combined reputation (village + culture): boycott -1024, hire 4096, friend of the village 8192, one of us 32768. Outlaw: grievance >= outlaw AND reputation <= boycott, or a killing inside the village in peacetime (immediate). Pardon: grievance < pardon AND reputation > boycott. A status earned by reputation is kept down to threshold x keepFactor. Grievance: weight x insideFactor (inside the village) x selfDefenseFactor (the victim struck first), halving every halfLifeDays. Favor is earned only by service (no trade source) and capped. Formal pardon (weregild): perGrievance reputation per grievance point above the pardon line, plus killFee while a peacetime killing is pending; refused unless reputation stays above the boycott line after paying. Apology (not outlaws): apologyPerGrievance Millénaire deniers per grievance point (64 = 1 denier argent) settles the grievance at once; reputation is untouched; 0 disables it. Diplomacy (envoys): a logistic success chance from bias[kind] + standing, relation, conflict, culture, distance, strength and repeated-attempt terms; delta is the relation change on success (Millenaire scale, +-jitter); envoys travel travelPer200 ticks per 200 blocks (at least minTravel); a truce holds the relation at truceFloor for truceDays; sow discord is Sworn-only with player and pair cooldowns, a rising Favor cost and exposure chance. Requests: detachments (Patron 4, Sworn 8; player-following escorts are deferred to a later phase) are lent garrison units the village can spare under its raid rule (minHome, kept sentry pairs and reserve); willingness falls with casualties on the player's errands and rises with Favor; Favor is paid on acceptance and lost per soldier killed on the errand. Cultures patch fields.
